decisions.reason: The existing message-53 MODIFY already captures the necessary effects on the dispensing path and retained matcha; the button-control details belong to the source Requirement.
Adopting an electrically actuated valve does not alter the existing requirement that the bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The solenoid actuation decision does not change the existing leak-containment requirement.
The existing message-53 MODIFY already records the accepted rendering match, stainless-steel material, and custom fabrication; no additional impact is missing.
The message reaffirms that the spout faces the baristas, which is already the candidate's current state and therefore requires no state change.
The approved dispensing approach does not establish a new removal or flushing method, so the existing cleanability requirement remains unchanged.
The accepted solenoid-valve and station-button approach necessarily adds that control circuit to the basic wiring plan.

source_message.text: Go ahead with that approach, and please match the rendering as closely as possible; I really like both its appearance and functionality. I do want one change from the rendering: move the plate labeled "Elena's Chai Whisk" from the back of the machine to the front. The spout and mixers will face the baristas, while customers will view the machine from another angle, so the "Elena's Chai Whisk" plate needs to face the customer.
